description: Fork of exp706 (E=96, d_v=16, 84.94M params, soft bs=16 8K = 1.4371). New compute regime: bs=48 * 16K steps = 393M tokens (matches exp710's regime, applied at E=96 d_v=16 instead of E=192 d_v=32). NOVEL recipe: backward_mode starts at 'hybrid_smooth', switches to 'soft' (hard fwd + K-row soft bwd) at hard_switch_step=8000 (the middle). LR schedule is CONTINUOUS over the full 16K (10% warmup + cosine to 0.1*peak) — NO restart at the switch. Tests: (a) does E=96 d_v=16 scale to the 393M-token regime; (b) does the mid-run soft->hard switch work cleanly without checkpoint roundtrip; (c) does ending in hard mode beat ending in soft at matched compute. References: exp706=1.4371 @ 84.94M soft 8K; exp713=1.4244 @ 84.94M soft 8K -> hard 4K = 12K total; exp710=1.2215 @ 116M bs=48 16K soft.
